claim: Running early? Mizuho 601 at 06:00 reaches Hiroshima at 07:25, and the pass covers it too.
fix: Mizuho 601 leaves Shin-Osaka at 06:00, one minute before the Metro arrives at 06:01, so it can't be caught; Sakura 741 at 06:25 is the first train you can take.
source_quote: 06:00→07:25 1時間25分 みずほ601号 鹿児島中央
